title: Pull requests wait for Copilot's review inside ci-ok
assertion: In the `swerepo-ci.yml` that `swerepo init` writes when the ruleset requests Copilot's review (also when github is applied on its own after ci), `ci-ok` waits for a `copilot-review` job that runs on pull requests only and whose `permissions:` block grants `pull-requests: read` and nothing else, and the `pull_request` trigger lists `types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]`, so a draft marked ready runs again. Run as written, with the values its own `env:` block maps from GitHub (`GH_TOKEN` included; the fake `gh` refuses without it), the job asks GitHub for exactly `repos/<repository>/pulls/<number>/reviews` with `--paginate`. It passes once that list holds a review by `copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]`, asking again when the first answer has none. It fails when none comes or only others reviewed (look-alike names included), and fails at once on a draft, without asking. `ci-ok`'s step fails on a pull request whose `copilot-review` didn't succeed, and on a push where it ran. With `--no-copilot-review` (also on a later run that turns the wait off) or a committed ruleset without Copilot review, there is no such job.

origin.text: The owner's decision (2026-11-23) and ADR-20261123-a359: merges wait for Copilot's review, because PR #3 was merged before its review arrived. Tightened after SeamSpec's reviewer and a second review: the fake gh answers only the reviews address with --paginate, the review arrives on a second ask, the job's env: and if: are checked, drafts don't ask at all, and the opt-out runs through the real flag. Tightened again at the owner's request before locking: GH_TOKEN must reach gh, the job's read-only permission, the trigger's place under pull_request, and turning the wait off on a later run. Then, after SeamSpec's reviewer: the permissions block must hold only pull-requests: read.
